dl_benchmarks_provenance.concatenation_order_caveat: Classical ML training (ml/train_category.py:43-47) concatenates operators in order [GP, BL, Robi], whereas Colab BanglaBERT fine-tuning (dl/finetune_banglabert.py:82-86) concatenates [GP, Robi, BL]. Paired t-tests between Hero Ensemble and BanglaBERT are evaluated on the 5 fold scores.
